Predicates:
Winner(x, y) ::: x is the winner of y.
Participate(x, y) ::: x participated in y.
Tie(x, y) ::: x is in a tie of y.
From(x, y) ::: x is from y.
Leaderboard(y) ::: y is a leaderboard.
Year(y, 1992) ::: y is in the year 1992.
Person(x) ::: x is a person.
FromBelgium(x) ::: x is from Belgium.
OnLeaderboard(x, y) ::: x is on the leaderboard y.
Participated(x, y) ::: x participated in y.
SixWayTie(y) ::: y is a six-way tie.
Premises:
Winner(Steinhauer, duMaurier1992) ::: Steinhauer was the winner of the 1992 du Maurier Classic.
Participate(Steinhauer, duMaurier1992) ::: Steinhauer participated in the 1992 du Maurier Classic.
∃x (SixWayTie(y) ∧ Tie(x, y) ∧ Person(x) ∧ FromBelgium(x)) ::: There was a six-way tie and one person in it was from Belgium.
From(Descampe, Belgium) ::: Descampé is from Belgium.
OnLeaderboard(Descampe, duMaurier1992) ::: Descampé is on the leaderboard of the 1992 du Maurier Classic.
∀x (OnLeaderboard(x, duMaurier1992) → Participate(x, duMaurier1992)) ::: All people on the leaderboard participated in the 1992 du Maurier Classic.
Conclusion:
∃x (SixWayTie(y) ∧ Tie(x, y) ∧ FromBelgium(x) ∧ OnLeaderboard(x, duMaurier1992)) ::: Descampé is in the six-way tie in the leaderboard of the 1992 du Maurier Classic.
